description: ONE informational recorder, never a Stop hook. SubagentStop on the lens's own agent type -> scripts/lens-record.js appends one trace-schema-v1 line per dispatch to .claude/verifiability-lens/trace.jsonl (a/b/u, escalations, verified/refuted, ms, tokens) and saves one real payload under samples/. Zero output, never blocks, stands down in judge children. The Stop hook that auto-dispatched the lens stays RETIRED (0.5.0): it fired 8 times over a single user request — its fire-once guard bounded CONSECUTIVE blocks, not total fires, and it keyed on a hash of the turn's text. Automatic firing is turn-end's 'quality-lens' duty, keyed on prompt_id.
